module: Read-only debug visualization of crawl mode trails, via debugDrawer: waypoints (spheres, direction arrows, labels) and segments, boundary zone, start position. Shared by the crawl editor and the in-game dev overlay to keep a consistent rendering. To be called every render frame.
notes: Colors: normal node white, recovery point yellow, bonus purple, last node blue; green arrow; light blue segments.
Nodes and segments beyond maxDist (400 m by default) from the camera are not drawn.
A node's sphere radius is node.radius (4.0 m by default); that of the start position is transform.radius (10.0 m by default).
This page exports no other functions; drawing does not modify any data.

drawPath.desc: Draws each node (sphere, arrow according to its rotation, label "index: name [REC]/[BONUS]") and the cylinders between consecutive nodes, optionally with the cumulative distance.

nodes.desc: Nodes: pos (vec3), radius, rotation (quat), name, flags (isRecoveryCheckpoint, isBonusCheckpoint).

opts.desc: {maxDist = number (m, 400 by default), showSegmentDistance = boolean, showLabels = boolean (true by default)}.

drawBoundary.desc: Draws the boundary zone by calling boundary:drawDebug(drawMode) (camera culling is done by the zone).

drawMode.desc: Draw mode passed as is to drawDebug.

drawStartingPosition.desc: Draws the start zone's sphere, a direction arrow and, if present, a small sphere at iconPosition.

startingPosition.desc: Start position: transform (position, rotation, radius) and iconPosition.
